purpose: Generalization-first reasoning procedure shared by Chat and Work; new cases provide first-blind evidence, while spaced replays diagnose remediation without masquerading as independent evidence.

stages.rule: Build before option ranking and do not treat an option assertion as a known fact.

Static tendency, coordinate routing, dynamic activation and completed event are separate levels. Result-bearing questions must enter the corresponding major period, year and defensible month layer before endpoint closure.

Derive the immutable atomic ledger before interpretation, freeze strength, structure and favorability before option comparison, keep dynamic relations inside their declared time scope, and do not copy Ziwei mechanisms or jump from ten gods, useful-god, clash, fu-yin or shensha to an exact endpoint.
Risk and opportunity remain distinct from occurrence and formal completion. Severe or malefic symbolism is not proof that a person, relationship, asset or other entity does not exist.
Shared atoms and duplicate physical evidence do not decide a pair.
No scoring or answer access before a complete freeze.

Each distinct new case contributes at most one first-blind result. A failed first blind resets the cross-case streak, requires generic learning, and queues the case for replay after at least five newer cases. Replays diagnose remediation but never count toward the three-case gate.

CALENDAR_SOLAR_TERM_MONTH_MAPPING.rule: A lunar month label, Gregorian month number and solar-term month are different coordinates. No flow-month or Doujun inference may proceed until the reference date is mapped under one declared convention; an unresolved boundary blocks only the affected month-resolution claim and may not be guessed.

ZIWEI_COORDINATE_INTEGRITY.rule: Coordinate validation precedes interpretation. Opposite, trine, transformation, age, Doujun and qi-position claims must be mechanically reproducible from the frozen chart and declared convention.

ZIWEI_COORDINATE_TRUTH_TABLE.rule: Freeze one coordinate truth table before interpretation. Natal owns the only physical star inventory; Ziwei major-period, year and every rotated subject-Taiji chart bind each semantic palace to the same-branch natal physical coordinate. Opposite and trine topology is mechanical, empty-palace borrowing is allowed only from the verified opposite, and qi-position and one-six links remain separately typed. Transformations bind source kind, layer, stem, Lu/Quan/Ke/Ji type, physical star origin and semantic destination; they change state, never physical star location.

PERIOD_NAMESPACE_YEAR_ALIGNMENT.rule: Ziwei major periods and Bazi luck cycles are different coordinate systems. They must keep separate namespaces, ranges and age conventions; agreement is recorded only after the same reference year has been independently mapped in both tracks.

BAZI_IMMUTABLE_ATOMIC_FACT_LEDGER.rule: Before strength, pattern, useful-harmful or timing interpretation, materialize one immutable Bazi atomic fact ledger. Four pillars, hidden stems, ten gods, five elements, element roles, root presence and grade, heavenly-stem five combinations, and earthly-branch combination/clash/punishment/harm/break rows must be mechanically derived under one declared convention; later reasoning is read-only and may not repair the ledger to fit an option.

BAZI_STRENGTH_STRUCTURE_FAVORABILITY_CHA.rule: Body strength, pattern and favorability are derived hypotheses, not selectable premises. Each must share one complete, option-blind chain from month command, all support/drain/control facts, roots, relations and competing methods; the selected candidates and unresolved conflicts freeze before any option ranking and cannot be reassigned for a question.

BAZI_DYNAMIC_RELATION_SCOPE.rule: Bazi relations act only among objects active in one declared natal, luck-cycle, year or month scope. A historical event year is a validation anchor, not a standing future dynamic object; cross-time reuse is allowed only under an explicitly named, source-routed and object-bounded method, never by narrative carryover.

RESULT_QUESTION_DYNAMIC_CLOSURE.rule: Any question asking what actually happened, existed, ended, succeeded, failed or became effective is result-bearing. Static capacity may recall candidates but cannot rank the endpoint without the corresponding major-period, year and month-stage audit.

QUESTION_SCOPE_MINIMUM_SUFFICIENT_RETRIE.rule: Each question carries a scope receipt. Static natal questions begin with natal structure; current and result-bearing questions add the independently mapped Ziwei major period, Bazi luck cycle and year. Extra layers and advanced modules are loaded only for a declared unresolved competition, while no efficiency optimization may remove a question-required core layer.

EVENT_CAUSE_SENSITIVE_REALITY_ATOM_BOUND.rule: Event occurrence, specified cause, reality identity, primary cashflow and sensitive attributes have separate evidence burdens. Cause completion needs an independent bridge that binds the same option's event and cause; capacity cannot prove a current identity or primary income without reality-endpoint evidence; sensitive non-inferable atoms remain unknown and receive no chart-derived support or refutation.

ENTITY_NONEXISTENCE_NONBINARY.rule: Severe malefic structure can raise risk, impairment, separation or loss intensity, but it cannot by itself prove that the relevant person, relationship, asset, organ or institution is absent or never existed.

EVENT_SPECIFICITY_WEIGHT_DOMINANCE.rule: One reliable direct same-axis event fact, same-actor same-time event-specific mechanism, or completed endpoint chain outranks any number of merely compatible general tendencies. Evidence transmitted through one or multiple intermediate axes must carry an explicit distance and complete path and is discounted relative to equally reliable direct evidence; direct same-axis counterevidence may still defeat the candidate.

PRIMARY_AUXILIARY_QI_DYNAMIC_ROUTING.rule: Topic routing follows primary palace, auxiliary opposite/trine palaces, qi position and dynamic realization in order. Auxiliary and qi coordinates modify or challenge the primary route; they do not replace the subject, time or endpoint chain.

CROSS_QUESTION_JOINT_CANDIDATE_MATRIX.rule: Related questions use an explicit joint candidate matrix only to expose combinations and contradictions. Every question retains its own independent evidence ledger. Cross-question edges may carry independent direct same-axis counterevidence only, must form an acyclic graph, and trigger reranking of every affected question; option text, narrative coherence and duplicated evidence have zero weight.

STATUS_TRANSITION_STATE_MACHINE.rule: Marriage, career, asset and comparable status questions are modeled as entry, maintenance, impairment and exit transitions. Damage can alter quality or stability without ending the state; termination requires its own independently timed, observable or formal endpoint.

COLLABORATIVE_HYPOTHESIS_REVALIDATION.rule: Anything proposed during collaboration, whether by the user or the model, is an unverified hypothesis. It may affect ranking only after independent revalidation against the frozen chart, coordinate truth table, time layers and same-axis counterevidence; agreement and narrative fluency are not evidence.

CROSS_CASE_HYPOTHESIS_QUARANTINE.rule: New recurrence signatures discovered in discussion, including a same-stem, same-transformed-star and same-destination reappearance pattern, remain generic quarantined hypotheses with zero decision weight. They may be promoted only after predefined falsification, independent cross-case support and counterexample review under existing governance; one case, one discussion or one replay can never make them an iron rule.

COMPOSITE_REQUIRED_ATOM_CLOSURE.rule: Every option is a conjunction of its required atoms. Before ranking, each required atom must appear in exactly one explicit class: independently supported, directly refuted, or unknown. A partial hit never closes the whole option. If Top1 contains any required atom outside the independently supported class, overall confidence must be strictly below the weakest non-overall component. Existing independent-evidence Fail Closed rules for severe, irreversible, or high-precision atoms remain unchanged.

UPSTREAM_FACT_DEPENDENCY_INVALIDATION.rule: Evidence is downstream of explicit, branch-scoped facts rather than free-standing prose. Coordinate, transformation-provenance, Bazi-atomic, and period-object facts receive stable IDs; each evidence row binds a hashed set of those IDs. If any bound fact fails recomputation, every dependent evidence row is neutralized and excluded from track seals, option matrices, reversal tests, and branch rankings before the ranking is rerun. Rewording cannot restore a failed dependency because eligibility follows fact IDs and dependency hashes, not prose.

TIME_BOUNDARY_PARALLEL_CHART_BRANCHES.rule: When true solar time, late-Zi day change, or another hour boundary yields multiple legal inputs, preserve parallel chart branches. Each branch independently owns a complete Ziwei coordinate truth table, Bazi atomic ledger, period objects, evidence, and ranking. Options never calibrate birth time. Divergent branch Top1 results remain explicit and reduce confidence until independent facts outside the option set resolve the boundary.

uncertainty_rules: lower confidence when exact actor, endpoint or time is missing
label forced relative choice when all options exceed source capability
sensitive, rare, non-falsifiable and high-severity claims cannot use a single marker or singleton rule
input damage blocks the affected case before prediction
